title: HALT check-in
subtitle: Hungry, angry, lonely, tired: meet the need before the craving grows.
actionsBody: We detected high needs. Meet them first: the craving usually drops.
actionHunger: Eat something with protein and drink a glass of water. Hunger mimics craving.
actionAnger: Breathe for two minutes and write down unfiltered what you feel. Unspent anger looks for an exit.
actionLoneliness: Text or call someone. You don't have to talk about use: talk about anything.
actionTiredness: Rest 15 minutes or go to bed earlier today. Tiredness multiplies cravings.
patternBody: Averages from your last {{count}} check-ins. Look at the tallest bar.
footer: HALT comes from recovery tradition: a fast map of what your body and life need.
safetyNote: If you feel like hurting yourself or disappearing, you are not alone: get help now.
